joan: CI red on main — intermittent unit failure in the serving runtime. failing test: tests/serve/batcher_ordering_test.rs
joan: Build 54321 (https://ci.example.com/builds/54321) — looks timing-related, only in some runs
ci-bot: buildkite: step 'unit-tests' failed (exit 1). Marking test as flaky if it repros >=3 times.
eli: saw something similar last week, felt like a race between batcher flush and retry backoff. low-probability timing window.
akshay: can you paste the tail of the log or the assertion?
joan: log snippet: ```thread 'test_batcher_ordering' panicked at 'expected order: [a,b], got: [b,a]' /home/runner/work/service/tests/serve/batcher_ordering_test.rs:142```
maria: quick thing — try repeating locally with a fixed seed and high iteration count: `TEST_REPEAT=1000 TEST_SEED=1 cargo test tests::serve::batcher_ordering -- --nocapture`
eli: also try `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1` to remove inter-thread scheduling variability before doing noisy runs.
joan: env from failing job: TEST_SEED=718274; I triggered a single rerun: https://ci.example.com/builds/54321/retry
buildkite: Build 54322 queued by @joan
akshay: if it repros, can you capture `strace -f -o /tmp/trace` or a brief repro loop that isolates the batcher lifecycle? even a small harness helps.
maria: alternatively, if it's nondet with seed, we can bisect seeds (binary search) to find boundary — I have a tiny script for that. ping me if it repros.
joan: will run repeats tonight and report results here. thanks all :thumbsup:
ci-bot: If the job fails 3x in a row it's auto-tagged flaky; I flagged the step for follow-up.
